decisions.scope: original-form mock exam geometry and sparse-page layout
rules: Triangle-network questions must not contain a dangling segment: every segment endpoint must meet the outer boundary or another segment.
Island-boundary questions use a closed outer frame and exactly one simple internal boundary with one top contact, one bottom contact, no left or right contact, and exactly two large regions.
Sparse final pages use a two-column by two-row quadrant grid, and every question starts at the top of its assigned quadrant.

decisions.scope: Final 1 question 18 and its source-linked similar questions
rules: The question figure shows the two-step fold sequence in the example exactly once.
The instruction to repeat the same fold sequence once more remains in the question text and is not redrawn in the example.
The final cut line is shown, but the unfolded result and answer-revealing construction are not shown in the question figure.

decisions.scope: all source-based geometry questions in problem screens and printable worksheets
rules: Open the exact source question number and use its original problem figure without redrawing, simplifying, rotating, mirroring, recoloring, or adding or deleting mathematical content.
Do not repeat the prompt as explanatory notes and do not draw intermediate calculations, completed repetitions, solution paths, construction lines, counts, or answer clues into the problem figure.
If changed numbers or conditions no longer agree with the original figure, keep the variant locked instead of inventing a replacement figure.
Detailed explanation and solution-only diagrams belong after answer reveal, not in the problem figure.
